window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes were thin for US and world coverage; only verifiable items are included.

stories.headline: Brazil's Federal Police find 1.25 tonnes of cocaine in a pickup and a hidden pit at a Maranhão farm
stories.body: On October 19, officers from the Pará and Maranhão regional units raided a rural property in Chapadinha. Dozens of bundles sat in a pickup's cargo bed and more were buried in a camouflaged excavation; three men were arrested in the act. Origin and destination of the load have not been disclosed.

stories.headline: Ecuador stops two vehicles with hidden compartments carrying 382 kilos of cocaine in Quinindé
stories.body: Interior Minister John Reimberg announced on October 17 that police in Quinindé, Esmeraldas province, near the Colombian border, found 234 blocks in one vehicle and 148 packages in another. Both had been fitted with concealed compartments, and two people were detained.
